answer: What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The pulse holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
